// why: Shared compiler defaults for the TypeScript workspaces. Every package and
the server extend this; the only deviation allowed per workspace is one
that is genuinely its own (apps/web brings DOM, JSX and the @/* alias,
contract-tests historically added allowJs for a JS server).
apps/web does not extend this file on purpose: its target/lib/jsx/paths are
a browser module graph, not a node one.
noImplicitAny is deliberately NOT set here. The server overrides it to
false with its own rationale comment; the packages keep the strict default.
